name: headscale
description: Headscale (Tailscale control server, SQLite): config and the SQLite DB (db.sqlite) live in the stack folder / data volume and are captured as a file copy - crash-consistent (SQLite WAL makes a live copy recoverable; the DB is tiny and writes are rare). No SQL detection applies (embedded DB), so 'No database detected' at create is expected. ESSENTIAL for restore: noise_private.key and derp/keys in the data dir - without them all nodes must re-register. They are inside the backup; restore the folder 1:1 and 'docker compose up -d'.
